answer:
Fixed. All 3 tests pass now (`Ran 3 tests ... OK`).

Root cause: `apply_discount` in `inventory.py:25` returned the amount taken off (`price * percent / 100`) instead of the price left after the discount. Changed it to `price * (100 - percent) / 100`, so `apply_discount(100, 10)` gives 90. Tests untouched. Only the test calls this function.

Risk: `change.diff` is not applied and is not part of this fix. Its `remove_sold_out` removes items from the list while looping over it, so when two sold-out items sit next to each other the second one is skipped. Fix that before merging it.
